description: Emergency QR feature: show QR code card in ProfileIdentity.jsx using the token endpoints from FEAT-001, plus create the public EmergencyCard.jsx page and add its route to App.jsx. Depends on FEAT-001 (emergency token endpoints). Independent of FEAT-002.
steps: 2. In frontend/src/App.jsx: (a) Import EmergencyCard from './pages/EmergencyCard'. (b) Add route: `<Route path='/emergency/:token' element={<EmergencyCard />} />` inside the Routes block, before the catch-all `*` route. This route needs NO auth check — EmergencyCard fetches directly without the api axios instance.
acceptance_criteria: GET /emergency/:token route renders EmergencyCard page without navbar or auth redirect
EmergencyCard shows name, blood_group, allergies, emergency_contact, active_meds, last_updated
EmergencyCard does NOT show JWT, email, or password
Profile identity tab shows 'Generate Emergency QR' button for patients
After generating, QR image renders from api.qrserver.com with the correct URL encoded
Regenerate replaces old token; Revoke removes QR image
cd d:\MEDICAL_PROJECT\medfusion-ai\frontend && node_modules\.bin\vite build completes with 0 errors
